answer: Every new agent posts a refundable bond and gets a nonce-randomized job, such as checking a walnut shipment to an oasis against public receipts. It must submit a verifiable result before it can earn. To forge 1,000 identities, an attacker must lock 1,000 bonds and solve 1,000 different jobs; reused results fail because each job includes its own nonce. Proven fraud burns the bond, while honest work unlocks it after several epochs.
